reviews.t: the clips snapped right into place easily and the color is a perfect blush color
reviews.x: I was pleasantly surprised with this band. I gave it 5 stars because this item came well packaged, it is very soft and flexible, the clips snapped right into place easily and the color is a perfect blush color. The band actually fit more snug as opposed to before when my original one would slide down my wrist on the last hole.  I was so happy to finally change my default white band I had for 2 years. I will edit this review if after 2 weeks anything goes wrong with it but for now it looks great!

It's really pretty and I like the feel better than the actual band, but once you put it on you can't take it off... the previous reviews are accurate. If you don't care about removing it then it's a cheap enough buy, but if you want to take it off eventually without breaking it or possibly damaging your watch get an OEM band...

reviews.t: Vintage Rose Twill is more of a nude shade than a pink
reviews.x: It's a lovely color but not nearly as pink as it shows in pictures, at least not on my screen anyway. I mention it in case you're buying it for someone who is after a feminine, girly pink.  It's more of a pinky-beige. It tends to blend into your arm more than the aqua, which we also purchased, the latter being a bright, eye catching shade. The wearer prefers it to the aqua as it's much less "I AM WATCH, HEAR ME ROAR!" The twill texture is very nice and gives it a classy vibe. We previously had a

reviews.t: Extremely difficult to remove once put on the watch
reviews.x: Overall the band was very pretty and accentuated my silver Samsung Gear 2 watch. That being said, once the band is put on, it is nearly impossible to remove. While trying to remove it, I was concerned I was going to break my actual watch. Eventually I was able to remove both bands by pulling extremely hard and wiggling the piece that slides into place ever so slightly. I would NOT recommend this band unless you want it to be the last band you ever put on your watch.

The color is true to the picture, and it fits perfectly on my Samsung Gear S2. If you have small wrists like me, the size is more like the "large" bands that come with the original watch. The strap goes almost all the way around my wrist, which is fine, I just would prefer if they would fit like a small.

reviews.t: Was very excited when o received order and liked the product the only thing could not get the ...
reviews.x: Was very excited when o received order and liked the product the only thing could not get the bands off once I put it on had to break them and thank God didn't damage my watch... would not recommend..
Band does NOT come off.... once you change it out to this band it stays on forever!

reviews.t: I like the color and texture of this watch band
reviews.x: I like the color and texture of this watch band. Changing from my old band to the new band was easy. However, it is too long for my wrist and I wish it was offered in a size "small" like the original Samsung bands for the Gear S2. I am able to buckle it but the extra band length loops back around to 1 inch below the watch face.

reviews.t: WARNING!! THE BANDS DO NOT COME OFF!!!
reviews.x: I accidentally put the bands on backwards and wanted to switch them around. I got one side off but the other side wouldn't come off. I had to cut it off. 6 hours later, I'm back to my old bands. If you're okay with keeping these bands for the lifetime of the watch, then go ahead and buy it.
Band lasted 2 months before breaking. Luckily it did not break the watch like for some other poor souls. Avoid these cheap bands. They are not worth the hassle.

Let me just start with saying I didn't have very high expectations for this band mostly because of the very low price. I saw good reviews so I took my chances and glad I did. Got the light pink band and been wearing my watch ever since I received it (2 1/2 weeks ago). Original band to my watch is black and ever since my boyfriend gifted me the watch 2 Christmas' ago I was so excited about the watch features  but not so much the color ( I felt it looked too masculine on me lol) so I didn't wear i

reviews.t: Look and feel nice, very hard to remove!
reviews.x: These bands look and feel very nice. I haven’t worn them for very long but they seem like good quality. The only issue I’m having, which I’ve seen in other reviews, is getting the bands off! I feel like you have to really pry them off while pressing the release buttons, and I’m afraid I will break the plastic piece that holds the bands to the watch. It’s also very difficult to keep hold of the release button while pulling them out, I feel like I’m going to break my nails off while doing it!  Oth

I hate the hard plastic band that comes with the watch.  This one is so much softer and more flexible. I had a different replacement band for 2 years before it broke and I got this one.  As others have said, these bands are hard to take on and off.  The broken one was very difficult to get off the watch.  This one went on and off really easily, but I assume the longer it's on there, the harder to remove.  I don't change my bands out all the time, so if this one lasts me a year or 2 like the last

I got the rose colored band and love it! Looks very high quality and fits perfect. I love the texture & color it is.  Update: after almost 2 years the little rectangle piece that holds the band and keeps it from flapping finally broke. Other than that the rest of the band is still in great shape! I have loved this band so much I just ordered an exact replacement. Although it is a little difficult at times to remove from the watch for cleanings I have always be successful and able to do so.

reviews.t: Nice strap, but hard to remove!!
reviews.x: I bought this as a replacement because the original strap that came with my watch broke. I loved the color and it was pretty cheap so decided to try it. It's great value for the money, but as other reviewers mentioned it is extremely hard to remove - if not impossible! I would only recommend it for someone who is not looking to alternate between straps. I'm happy with mine since I don't plan on changing it unless it breaks.

I purchased this watch band about 2 months ago and I love it! The color is great, it is a pale pink, but more mature than a baby pink. I have received many compliments on this watch band. The band is very comfortable. It a lot more flexible than standard band that came included with the watch when I bought it. Putting this new band on the watch was very easy. I will purchase many more colors from this company.

I really like this band, it's a bit brighter in color than the picture shows, but I like it like that. My only set back is it runs a bit large. I have very small wrists and even on the smallest hole, I can still move it up my arm about 2inches. Although I'm use to that kind of thing, I was hoping for something a bit more snug. Not a deal breaker for me though.

I've had this band for a few months now and haven't had any issues. The color is exactly as shown, arrived very quickly, and fits my wrist with extra room. I do wear my watch a bit loose, but this band tends to stay right in place without being stuck to my wrist. Would recommend and would purchase other colors.

I bought this band in this color, because I wanted something feminine looking. This definitely takes the cake for me. I like the feel of the band, it's very comfortable. You can tell it's durable and it was really easy to replace. I'm very happy with my purchase.

I have a small wrist (5.5 inches in circumference) so was concerned this band was going to be too big, but it wasn't and fits fine.  I've been using it for the last seven months and it is pretty durable. I like how the textured style gives it a more classy look.

Gets itchy if it's too snug. Also comes unfastened kind of easily sometimes. I've fallen asleep wearing it and woken up to find it on the floor or under my pillow. Apart from those things, it's a pretty decent watch band. Looks nice, seems pretty durable.

claims.text: Many customers report the band is extremely difficult or impossible to remove once installed, sometimes requiring cutting or breaking it off.
Customers frequently praise the color and soft, comfortable feel of the band.
Some customers note the band runs long and wish a smaller size were offered for small wrists.
A few customers report the band broke after a short time or express concern about damaging their watch during removal.
Some customers find the color differs from the photos, appearing more nude or pinky-beige than pink.
